ns2:section.sectionTitle: Youth & Cit in a Digital Age
ns2:section.sectionText: Online and Continuing Education (OCE) restrictions and assessments apply, see http://www.oce.illinois.edu. GSE cohort 11 students only. EPS 590 HER replaces the required EPS 590 IDC course. Blackboard Collaborate (also known as Elluminate) will be used. This course is part of a self-supporting program and DOES NOT accept the following tuition and fee waivers (TFWs): Cooperating Teacher waivers, Non-Academic waivers (including UIUC employees and employees of other state institutions), Academic waivers from UIUC, UIC and UIS employees, Related Agency waivers, Field Supervisor waivers or Retiree waivers. This program DOES accept statutory waivers (veterans grants, etc.) and waivers granted through fellowships/assistantships as governed by the Graduate College at UIUC. The waiver policy above is subject to moderate changes in accordance with the actions of the University of Illinois, Board of Trustees.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to EDM: Ed Policy St - UIUC.
ns2:section.sectionFeeAmount: OCE Tuition $362.00 per Bill Hour, and OCE Fees $50.00 per Bill Hour.
